description: Fleet-wide M365 backup assurance for SkyKick Cloud Backup - posture, stale snapshots, and coverage gaps no portal or wrapper can show.

tools.name: alerts_complete
tools.description: Mark a specific alert as complete. Required: alertId.

tools.name: alerts_list
tools.description: List alerts for a backup service or email migration order (max 500; the API does not support skip paging). Required: serviceId. Optional: top (default: 25).

params.name: serviceId
params.description: Backup Service GUID or Email Migration Order GUID

tools.name: backup_autodiscover
tools.description: Auto-discover state (enabled/disabled) for Exchange and SharePoint. Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_by-partner
tools.description: List backup subscription orders for a specific partner. Required: partnerId. Returns array of Subscription.

params.name: partnerId
params.description: Partner GUID to list subscriptions for

tools.name: backup_datacenters
tools.description: List the Azure data centers available for backup storage. Returns array of Datacenter.

tools.name: backup_discover-mailboxes
tools.description: Trigger Exchange mailbox discovery (async; poll the returned operation with watch-operation). Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_discover-sites
tools.description: Trigger SharePoint site discovery (async; poll the returned operation with watch-operation). Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_jobs
tools.description: Active backup jobs for the subscription (known upstream defect: may return Unknown error, community-reported since 2024). Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_last-snapshot-stats
tools.description: Last snapshot statistics for all mailboxes in the subscription. Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_list
tools.description: List all placed backup subscription orders across your customers. Returns array of Subscription.

tools.name: backup_mailbox
tools.description: Details of a specific Exchange mailbox in the subscription. Required: subscriptionId, mailboxId.

tools.name: backup_mailboxes
tools.description: Exchange mailboxes and their backup enabled/disabled status (IndividualMailboxes array). Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_retention-period
tools.description: Data retention periods for Exchange and SharePoint (response field ExchangeRentionPeriodInDays is the upstream spelling). Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_sites
tools.description: SharePoint site URLs and their backup enabled/disabled status. Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_sku
tools.description: SKU and promotional details for a backup subscription. Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_storage-settings
tools.description: Storage settings for a backup subscription. Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: backup_subscription-settings
tools.description: Subscription settings: Exchange/SharePoint backup state, enabled counts, customer info. Required: subscriptionId.

tools.name: identity_whoami
tools.description: Show the identity and context of the authenticated API user.

tools.name: operations_status
tools.description: Poll the status of an async operation (e.g. a discovery run). Required: operationId.

params.name: operationId
params.description: Operation GUID returned by an async action

tools.name: operations_workqueue
tools.description: Retrieve the work queue for the authenticated account.
